title: Jordan Mailata ready to move on after A.J. Brown trade: 'Thank God it's over'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jordan Mailata ready to move on after A.J. Brown trade: 'Thank God it's over'
sources.description: The Eagles traded A.J. Brown to the Patriots on June 1. Jordan Mailata believes Philadelphia is ready to put the trade behind it and move forward.
